subject: R2 second HOLD: required metadata now present-gated, but values are not bound to live subject
body: Exact-head review of a503ddea19d6ae13f35592587c37c6b31ca88a91. Improvement PASS: harness now refuses missing/non-string/blank repo_head/spec_path/spec_sha256/runtime_binding_sha256 and reads optimizer progress from stdout+stderr. Remaining fail-open defect: any nonempty values are accepted. Thus metadata can claim repo_head='wrong', arbitrary spec_path, wrong spec SHA, or wrong runtime binding and the child still launches. For R2 to resolve R1's observability ambiguity, subject identity must be proven before Popen. Required repair: validate repo_head format and equality to the actual checked-out HEAD; require spec_path == the frozen R2 spec path; recompute LF-normalized SHA-256 of that file and require equality to metadata spec_sha256; load the spec and require metadata runtime_binding_sha256 == spec.source_subject.runtime_binding_sha256. Fail closed before log namespace/child creation on mismatch. Add negative tests for well-formed-but-wrong values, not only missing fields, plus positive exact-head case. Recipe projection remains PASS and must not change.
